codes.activity: Tap to cues, read path and cards, write two data sentences
codes.where: Four rounds, path view, graph, sentence cards
parts_missing: touch receptor cue (touch appears only as an info card, no touch round)

skill: Use your own reaction times to explain how receptors send messages to the brain for quick action or memory
setting: Body figure beside a big tap pad
screen_adds: It times each tap in milliseconds, lights the signal path step by step and graphs the student's own rounds, which a worksheet could not measure.
paper_gap: Millisecond timing after a random wait, with the student's own times graphed at once (the Ruler drop extra approximates it on paper).
unsure: MS-LS1-8 wording taken from the spec quote
sentence check is only that each card asks for a number from the graph; not sure the tool can test it, so check is tool-rule
table says touch cues but rounds are light, sound, choice, sequence
memory claim rests on practice speedup, which is only suggestive

codes.activity: Set block and water, predict final temperature, drop, read ledger
codes.where: Cup mode (default), Particles, Dare cards D1 to D5
parts_missing: plan the investigation with a stated question
write a claim with evidence about more uniform energy distribution
name the second law of thermodynamics
codes.unit_adds: Students pose their own question, vary one setting at a time, record runs in the lab book and write a claim with evidence tying the result to more uniform energy distribution and the second law.

skill: Predict where hot and cold objects meet and see why heat only flows one way
setting: Lab bench with foam cup, hot metal block and thermometers
screen_adds: It runs the exchange live with an energy ledger and a particle view showing energy crossing both ways, which a board or worksheet could not animate.
paper_gap: The particle box with live energy-passed bars and instant reruns across eight materials.
beatable: D4 No flow: few settings, flat-line feedback, free tries; equal temperatures can be found by sliding
D5 Best warmer: eight materials with free reruns, trial is cheaper than reasoning about specific heat
unsure: HS-PS3-4 wording not printed in packet; used the NGSS wording from memory (plan and conduct an investigation, closed system, more uniform energy distribution)
prediction is optional, so explored may be generous
Dare is a separate mode, so the keyed checks (D1 to D5) may be off the main path
D3 reveals its explanation after three tries, so the dare can be passed on by waiting
